caption: The drawing depicts a single pewter tankard with a domed lid, rendered in shades of gray with detailed shading to suggest a metallic surface. The tankard is cylindrical, tapering slightly toward the bottom, and features a rounded base with a narrow horizontal band near the bottom and another near the lid. The lid is smoothly domed with a raised rim and is topped with a solid, rounded knob. A large, curved handle is attached to the right side of the tankard, with a decorative thumb rest and a pronounced curve. The tankard appears centered within a rectangular border, and the background is left plain and uncolored. The artist's signature, "Charles Cullen," is visible at the bottom right outside the border.
title: Pewter Tankard
